original_value: The Kuramoto–Sinelshchikov–Velarde equation describes the evolution of a phase turbulence in reaction-diffusion systems or the evolution of the plane flame propagation, taking into account the combined influence of diffusion and thermal conduction of the gas on the stability of a plane flame front. In this paper, we prove the well-posedness of the classical solutions for the Cauchy problem.

result.paraphrase: The Kuramoto–Sinelshchikov–Velarde equation models the development of phase turbulence in reaction-diffusion systems, as well as plane-flame propagation, while accounting for the combined effects of diffusion and gas thermal conduction on the stability of a planar flame front. In this paper, we establish the well-posedness of classical solutions to the Cauchy problem.
